title: 解码方法 II
summary: 数字字符串中星号可代表 1 到 9 任一数字，统计把字符串按 1 到 26 解码成字母的方案数并取模。
insight: 每个位置的方案由单字符解码数乘 dp[i-1]，加上与前一字符组成两位数的组合数乘 dp[i-2]。
pitfalls: 两个星号组成合法两位数有十五种
字符 0 只能作为 10 或 20 的后一位

solutions.title: 单字符与双字符组合计数
solutions.idea: 滚动保存前一位和前两位方案数，并按字符模式计算乘数。
steps: 从第二字符起计算 single*previousOne+pair*previousTwo
每步取模并滚动，返回 previousOne

code.java: class Solution { public int numDecodings(String s){long mod=1000000007L,previousTwo=1,previousOne=single(s.charAt(0));for(int i=1;i<s.length();i++){long current=(single(s.charAt(i))*previousOne+pair(s.charAt(i-1),s.charAt(i))*previousTwo)%mod;previousTwo=previousOne;previousOne=current;}return(int)previousOne;}private int single(char c){return c=='*'?9:c=='0'?0:1;}private int pair(char a,char b){if(a=='*')return b=='*'?15:b<='6'?2:1;if(a=='1')return b=='*'?9:1;if(a=='2')return b=='*'?6:b<='6'?1:0;return 0;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun numDecodings(s:String):Int{val mod=1000000007L;var previousTwo=1L;var previousOne=single(s[0]).toLong();for(i in 1 until s.length){val current=(single(s[i])*previousOne+pair(s[i-1],s[i])*previousTwo)%mod;previousTwo=previousOne;previousOne=current};return previousOne.toInt()};private fun single(c:Char)=if(c=='*')9 else if(c=='0')0 else 1;private fun pair(a:Char,b:Char):Int=if(a=='*'){if(b=='*')15 else if(b<='6')2 else 1}else if(a=='1'){if(b=='*')9 else 1}else if(a=='2'){if(b=='*')6 else if(b<='6')1 else 0}else 0 }
code.cpp: class Solution { int single(char c){return c=='*'?9:c=='0'?0:1;}int pairs(char a,char b){if(a=='*')return b=='*'?15:b<='6'?2:1;if(a=='1')return b=='*'?9:1;if(a=='2')return b=='*'?6:b<='6'?1:0;return 0;}public:int numDecodings(string s){const long long mod=1000000007;long long previousTwo=1,previousOne=single(s[0]);for(int i=1;i<(int)s.size();++i){long long current=(single(s[i])*previousOne+pairs(s[i-1],s[i])*previousTwo)%mod;previousTwo=previousOne;previousOne=current;}return previousOne;} };
